aside.two: Every action written to an audit log

register.title: Register your business
register.subtitle: Create an account to register instruments and apply for verification.
register.notice: This creates a platform account. It isn’t a licence or registration under the Legal Metrology Act — those are verified separately by the authority.

sections.orgDesc: The legal entity that owns the instruments.
sections.contactDesc: You’ll use these details to sign in.

register.name: Your full name
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters with upper and lower case letters and a digit
register.terms: I confirm the details are correct and accept the terms of use
register.termsDesc: Your details are used only to process verification and are visible to the authority.

done.title: Account created
done.desc: You can now sign in with {email}.

errors.name: Enter your full name.
errors.mobile: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6–9.
errors.password: Use at least 10 characters with upper and lower case letters and a digit.

verify.title: Verify a certificate
verify.desc: Enter the certificate number to check that it is genuine and currently valid.
verify.scanHint: Have the certificate with you? Scan its QR code with your phone camera instead.
verify.checkingDesc: Confirming the record and its integrity seal
verify.privacy: Only non-personal certificate details are shown. The holder’s identity and address are never displayed.

lookup.label: Certificate number
lookup.hint: The number is printed at the top of the certificate.
lookup.invalid: Enter a certificate number using letters, digits and hyphens.
lookup.notFound: No certificate was found with this number.
lookup.rateLimited: Too many checks. Please wait a minute and try again.
lookup.network: Couldn’t connect. Check your internet connection.
lookup.error: Verification is unavailable right now. Try again.

scan.title: Scan certificate QR code
scan.desc: Point your camera at the QR code printed on the certificate.
scan.hint: Hold the code inside the frame. It is read automatically.
scan.foreign: This QR code isn’t a certificate from this portal.
scan.unsupported: This browser can’t open the camera. Upload a photo of the QR code instead.
scan.denied: Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access or upload a photo of the QR code.
scan.noCamera: No camera was found. Upload a photo of the QR code instead.
scan.unreadable: No QR code could be read from this image. Try a sharper photo.

VALID.title: Valid certificate
VALID.desc: This certificate is genuine and currently in force.

EXPIRED.title: Certificate expired
EXPIRED.desc: This certificate was genuine but its validity has ended. The instrument must be re-verified.

SUSPENDED.title: Certificate suspended
SUSPENDED.desc: The authority has suspended this certificate. It isn’t valid at present.

REVOKED.title: Certificate revoked
REVOKED.desc: The authority has revoked this certificate. It is not valid.

INVALID.title: Certificate not found
INVALID.desc: No valid certificate matches this code. It may be mistyped or not genuine.

errors.desc: Please try again in a moment.
